title: AI Limbic System: Emotion & Memory as MCP Servers
full_monologue: **I built an AI limbic system where emotion and memory run like MCP servers.** Imagine neural networks that don’t just process data, but *feel* it. I designed a framework where emotional responses are stored and retrieved like database queries, and memories are indexed like files in a server. It’s not just AI—it’s a new kind of intelligence. Think of it as a brain with a backup plan. What if your AI could remember your mood from yesterday and adapt accordingly? What would that look like in real life?
